title: New Developments for Single Particle Cryo-EM Data Processing in CryoSPARC
content: Single particle cryo-EM (cryo-electron microscopy) enables high-resolution imaging of macromolecular complexes in close-to-native state, at near-atomic resolutions. Cryo-EM sample preparation and hardware continue to make rapid progress, but there remain key computational challenges in dealing with heterogeneity, obtaining high resolution structures of small and transmembrane proteins, and automating 3D structure determination for rapid drug discovery projects.
